lines.1: I'm not getting up that easily.
lines.2: Those drowsy morning moments are precious.
lines.3: No way was I letting her trample all over them.
lines.6: The sole of Otome's foot was planted on my shoulder.
lines.7: In plain terms, she was stepping on me.
lines.8: 「Did you not hear me? It is morning. Wake up.」
lines.9: She kept grinding her foot into my shoulder, kneading it around.
lines.10: 「Ow-ow-ow! That's a brutal way to wake someone up!」
lines.11: 「It will become more brutal if you do not rise.」
lines.13: I couldn't deal with violence first thing in the morning.
